title: Root-controlled public storage activation
summary: Corrected Cloudron release activation so the shared public-storage link is installed by the root-controlled deployment path before application commands run.
changes: Moved public-storage link installation out of the application user process and into the root-controlled immutable release preparation step.
Added fail-closed target and ownership checks so the application user cannot replace the release public directory or redirect the shared storage link.
affected_areas: Cloudron release activation and immutable shared-storage preparation
version_rationale: A backward-compatible patch correcting the deployment-time public-storage link boundary discovered during the v0.8.0 production activation attempt.
validation: Deployment contract tests require root-controlled link creation before Artisan, exact shared-storage targeting, and a non-writable immutable public directory for the application user.
The complete SQLite, MySQL 8.4, MariaDB 11.4, frontend, packaging, authenticated-control, migration, authorization, health, and OIDC deployment gates remain required before release.
known_limitations: This patch changes deployment preparation only and does not alter the v0.8.0 authorization or Admin feature set.
rollback: Restore the exact pre-activation application release while retaining the forward-only Phase B database migration; the authenticated control and backup boundaries remain unchanged.
provenance: Defined by the production activation evidence for Phase B of MyAPES Account issue #10.
